_comment: WHI-1597 hand-derived rates, derived on paper from the formulae in docs/references/research-022/output-bounds.md (not computed by any bound code). tests/pools/test_output_bounds_contract.py recomputes the R2 outputs through pools.quote.quote_exact_in and compares the hand rates with the contract rate functions.

r2_cpmm.derivation: r = (10000-30)*1000 / (10000*1000) = 997/1000. Marginal q(2)-q(1) = 1 > r*1 = 0.997, so q(x+m)-q(x) <= r*m is false and a slack s >= 0.003 (the contract uses s = 1) is needed.

rate_cases.name: cl tick 0 fee 3000 pips
rate_cases.derivation: getSqrtRatioAtTick(0) = 2**96 exactly (Q128 ratio 2**128 >> 32), so price^2 / 2**192 = 1 and the rate is (1e6-3000)/1e6 = 997/1000 both ways

rate_cases.name: lb id 2**23+1 step 10 baseFactor 0 (price 1.001 to 1e-30)
rate_cases.derivation: base = 1 + 10/10000 = 1.001; one bin above the unit price: X->Y rate 1.001 = 1001/1000, Y->X rate 1/1.001 = 1000/1001; the 128-bit fixed-point price differs from 1.001 by < 1e-30
